submission.natural_language_explanation: L3/H5 is an induction (repeat-continuation) head: it fires while the current tokens extend a multi-token span that already occurred earlier in context (two or more matching tokens, including subword pieces of a repeated word, phrase, or list item), attending back to the token that followed the earlier occurrence and routing that continuation forward. Its output grows as the match extends and collapses when the repeat breaks, and it stays near baseline on unrepeated text and on single-token repeats of common words.
